---
title: "Minimal pairs"
toc: false
---

Two hundred written pairs, ten per word. In each pair the subject, its determiner and number, and the verb form are the same; only the rest of the predicate changes, from an occasion to the kind. The numbers are probe(A) − probe(O), from a probe trained on the other half of the words: above zero, the abstract-mode sentence sits further toward abstract-mode. For the decoder's target-word readout both sentences of a pair have the same words up to the target, so its two states are identical and every difference is zero.
